_comment: Google Drive folder IDs for this client's content pipeline. Read this file at the start of generate-batch's Drive-publish step (Step 7) so folder IDs live in one place.
_structure: <Content root>/<Week N (date range)>/<D-DDMMYYYY-DAY>/<Platform[-N]>/, where D is 1-5 for Mon-Fri (fixes Drive's alphabetical sort, which otherwise puts Monday's DDMMYYYY string after Tuesday's). The week folder reuses the exact 'Week N (date range)' string already in every piece's own metadata, not a separate ISO week number. Only channels marked active in brand/brand_config.json's channel_config publish here. A platform folder only gets the -2/-3 suffix when a later, distinct piece of the SAME platform lands on the same date.
_setup: Both IDs are one-time setup values, created once per client during onboarding, not search-or-created per run (unlike the week/day/platform folders underneath content_root_folder_id, which generate-batch creates on demand each batch). content_root_folder_id is the top-level Drive folder this client reviews from. summary_sheets_folder_id is a separate folder (a sibling, not nested under the content root) that generate-batch uploads each batch's summary sheet into as a native Google Sheet; the n8n workflow (automation/n8n-image-generation-workflow.json) watches this same folder ID in its own Drive Trigger node, so the two must stay in sync if either folder is ever recreated. Create both folders in the client's Drive, record their IDs here, and confirm the n8n workflow's Drive Trigger points at the same summary_sheets_folder_id before the first real run.
